name: CSAT
summary: The shared thumbs up/down satisfaction prompt — the one CSAT control, not a bespoke rating.
highlights: Shared thumbs up and down satisfaction prompt
The one CSAT control, not a bespoke rating
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-csat> — the reusable form of the feedback pattern's CSAT rule. A binary thumbs-up/down prompt with a required `source` for typo-proof analytics segmentation; it emits a composed `rate` event, and once rated only the chosen thumb remains (clicking it again un-rates), and a thumbs-down opens a free-text feedback popover that emits a composed `feedback` event on submit. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; the thumbs are the shared <aha-icon> BY NAME, the follow-up reuses the shared <aha-popover> + <aha-counted-textarea> + <aha-button>, and the selected/hover states animate on PERSISTENT button nodes (class toggle, no rebuild). Zero drift.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin wrapper that listens for the `rate` and `feedback` events; Vue binds the custom element natively. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Layout
spec.value: borderless single row (24px high): 12px #616161 prompt, 4px gap, then 28×24 borderless thumb buttons with 16px #4A4A4A icons and no gap between them — the only layout (legacy `inline` is a no-op)

spec.label: Hover
spec.value: ghost fill #F9F5FF · icon #8644D4 purple-50 (motion tokens) · tooltip Useful / Not useful / Feedback

spec.label: Selected
spec.value: the presenter's antd tertiary active state — fill #F0E4FF (purple-15) · icon #6A1EBB (purple-60) · aria-pressed synced; hover keeps the selected look

spec.label: Collapse
spec.value: once rated only the chosen thumb remains (the other is hidden); clicking the chosen thumb again un-rates — both thumbs return, `value` is removed and `rate` fires with rating null

spec.label: Thumbs-up
spec.value: rates instantly — reflects value='up', hides the thumbs-down, emits `rate`

spec.label: Thumbs-down
spec.value: registers value='down' + emits `rate`, hides the thumbs-up, then opens a feedback popover (shared <aha-popover>, role=dialog · Esc/outside-click close) anchored to the thumbs group and always fully visible (it flips above the thumbs when the CSAT sits at the bottom of the viewport, stays inside the side edges, and renders in the browser top layer, so no overflow, transform or contain:paint ancestor clips it and no sidebar or toast covers it) — a 20px X whose hover is a rounded square (6px radius) (closes only, never submits, keeps the down rating), an <aha-counted-textarea> (focused on open) and a secondary Send button that stays disabled until text is typed; after Send it closes and does not re-open on thumbs-down until the rating changes again; the heading is optional (`feedback-prompt`, none by default)

spec.label: Feedback button
spec.value: opt-in `feedback-button` — a chat icon immediately right of the thumbs (tooltip Feedback), visible whether or not rated, that opens the same popover without changing the rating; submitting clears the field so feedback can be sent again

spec.label: Thank-you
spec.value: opt-in `thanks` — check + success #16C49A line fades in (motion tokens): instantly on up, after feedback submit on down; never for feedback sent while unrated

spec.label: Events
spec.value: `rate` → { rating: 'up' | 'down' | null, source } (null when un-rated) · `feedback` → { rating: 'up' | 'down' | null, source, feedback } (null when unrated — the Feedback button needs no rating)

props.name: prompt
props.desc: Optional question shown before the thumbs

props.name: source
props.desc: Stable placement token for analytics — passed in the rate and feedback events

props.name: value
props.desc: The current rating (also reflects a click, removed on un-rate); the other thumb is hidden while set, and the selected thumb's aria-pressed syncs

props.name: thanks
props.desc: Opt-in thank-you line — shown (role=status) after rating (on down, after feedback submit); fades in on a persistent node

props.name: feedback-prompt
props.desc: Optional heading in the feedback popover, beside the X — none by default

props.name: feedback-button
props.desc: Show the Feedback chat-icon button after the thumbs; it opens the feedback popover without rating

props.name: feedback-button-placeholder
props.default: How can we improve? Let us know!
props.desc: Placeholder when the popover is opened from the Feedback button (falls back to feedback-placeholder)

props.name: feedback-placeholder
props.default: How can we improve? Let us know!
props.desc: Placeholder for the free-text field in the feedback popover

whenToUse.when: a lightweight satisfaction check on a feature or a piece of content
a full-block outcome after an operation
you need structured, multi-field feedback with validation

opinion.note: Use the shared control — never build a bespoke rating. Always pass a stable `source` per placement so segmentation stays typo-proof. Keep it to the binary thumbs (plus the optional Feedback button); show the “Thank you for your feedback!” toast from the `feedback` event with the shared toast hook, and omit `thanks` when the thumbs should stay on screen; free-text is asked for ONLY after a thumbs-down (the built-in feedback popover), and never block rendering on tracking.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — this is the reusable component form of the feedback pattern's CSAT rule (parts/feedback.guide.md): a binary thumbs widget with a required source token, and the 'ask for free-text only after a thumbs-down' follow-up realised by reusing <aha-popover> + <aha-counted-textarea> + <aha-button>. The dedicated `feedback` event maps to the pattern's distinct CSAT_FEEDBACK_SUBMITTED analytics event (separate from CSAT_RATED). Colours + motion map to the token layer. A deliberate, documented AhaSlides surface.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. The [data-probe] probe is pre-rated (value='up') so the borderless single-row layout — the muted #616161 400-weight 12px prompt, the borderless 28×24 thumb button, the selected primary colour and the aria-pressed a11y contract — is measurable; it also pins the thumbs-down feedback flow: the down thumb carries aria-haspopup='dialog' and the shared <aha-popover> is present in the shadow root.
